scope: Existing voice session lifetime only; one core and renderer route retained.
problem: Listener idle time was refreshed during core work but not while its renderer spoke. A long approved answer could trigger idle closure or leave too little user-response time.
changes: Count unfinished renderer speech handles as activity within existing bounded speech lifecycle.
Refresh listener activity after playback completion or cancellation; closed sessions stay closed.
Preserve current authorization check, interruption semantics and absolute 1800s maximum.

tests.mode: Existing seven-file voice suite in network-disabled dependency image; real say handles, controlled monotonic clock, synthetic renderer events.
cases: Active renderer playback after core work finishes does not idle-close.
Completed or cancelled speech starts a fresh normal listening interval.
Done/removed speech handles do not indefinitely retain the session.
Absolute lifetime still closes and cancels active playback.
tests.independentReview: distinctive_eva_review: no material blockers, source and regression review.

installation: One reviewed module over actual immutable current images in speaker and private voice media; service configuration preserved. Neither service had a running Codex transport before replacement.
limits: Controlled-time regression, not a measured long physical household conversation.
No new audio-quality, recognition, response-speed or family-acceptance claim.
Activity calendar-day and bounded result-content findings recorded separately; not changed by this fix.
privacy: No private transcripts, audio, credentials or session identities in this record.
